segments.he: בְּכָבוּל וּבְפֵאָה נׇכְרִית לֶחָצֵר. אָמַר רַב: כׇּל שֶׁאָסְרוּ חֲכָמִים לָצֵאת בּוֹ לִרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, אָסוּר לָצֵאת בּוֹ לֶחָצֵר — חוּץ מִכָּבוּל וּפֵאָה נׇכְרִית.
segments.en: It was taught in the mishna that a woman may go out «with a woolen cap or with a wig to the courtyard. Rav said:» With regard to «all» ornaments and garments with «which the Sages prohibited going out into the public domain» on Shabbat, «it is» also «prohibited to go out with» them «into the courtyard» due to the concern lest she forget and go out to the street, «with the exception of a woolen cap and a wig.»

moves.summary: general ban with cap and wig excepted
moves.about: the mishna's courtyard leniency for cap and wig is an exception to a general ban on wearing in a courtyard what is banned in the public domain
